proposedContributions.change: Define CapabilityDescriptor, CapabilityVersion, CapabilityGrant and ConsumerBinding references using accepted canonical EntityRef/Principal/ProviderConnection; typed capabilities.list/read, capability.grant/revoke and tool.preview/invoke requests/results. Include version/schemaHash/effect, resource/principal scopes, purpose/expiry/revision, asOf, commandId, receipt/outcome and policy revision. Accept no renderer actor or credentials. Model domain states separately from unchanged Rox2Status enums. Preview binds canonical args, target refs, source/schema and current policy into previewHash.

Implement authorized cursor list/read against canonical persistence: filter by text/provider/state/effect only after current resource policy, redact denied titles/count/schema/examples and return authorized asOf/version/provenance. Discovery reconciles current pool/provider metadata without granting permission or copying secret payloads; adapter discovery failure is degraded/needs_auth, not empty.

Implement revision-checked grant/revoke and preview/invoke through the accepted authority gateway. Grant preview yields no active permission; Apply returns a durable receipt. Invoke validates pinned schema/args and previewHash before provider, intersects actor/resource/connection/capability scopes, deduplicates commandId with durable command ledger, invokes existing pool via adapter, distinguishes local_durable/provider_accepted/readback and unknown_provider_outcome, and reconciles without blind replay of uncertain writes. Revoke advances policyEpoch, retracts projections/definitions and cancels active calls only where supported. Register discovered/version_changed/grant_changed/revoked and invocation_requested/completed/failed through commit-bound outbox. Required background reconciliation/expiry/refresh consumes accepted job/event mechanisms; registration patches remain lead-owned.

Add capability_descriptors(providerConnectionId,externalToolId,version,schemaHash,effect) with Unique(providerConnectionId,externalToolId,version), and capability_grants(resourceScope,principalScope,purpose,expiry,revision), canonical IDs/workspace ownership and accepted connection/binding linkage. Use existing secret authority and command ledger/outbox, no new secret storage. Migration numbering/aliases/runner registration and upgrade transaction conventions require foundation owner approval.

Implement one searchable capabilities table/detail/drilldown consumed by Connections and SourceInfo/Admin links: version/input-output schema/effects/scopes/principals/purpose/expiry/audit/asOf; explicit draft Availability/Apply receipt, read-only fixture check with Cancel, preview separate from dispatch and revision-checked revoke summary. Preserve filters, selection/scroll and scoped drafts across errors/navigation, invalidate forbidden drafts on policy changes. Use existing React shell/native controls/tokens/preferences and t() only; truthful unsupported/degraded/offline/unknown states and full keyboard/help/narrow/zoom/reduced-motion behavior.

Cover all five normative conformance scenarios and end-to-end Configure→preview→agent invoke→reload→revoke across Sessions/Pages, API equivalents, denied metadata, org/private target scope, schema drift, concurrency/reconnect and seeded guard removal. Fixture registry tests do not substitute for real provider-live execution. Permanent assertions must observe behavior/persisted output rather than wiring/source text.

Pi advertises pool definitions separately while OMP uses this builder; changing only buildSessionToolDefs misses Pi and other pool callers. Backend migration exact paths must be supplied/inspected in the lead integration scope.
Source slug, external tool name, connection ID and canonical EntityRef/version are different identities; stable mapping and version mismatch rejection are required.
Existing grant/binding/audit operations are sequential and broker store writes are unawaited; capability receipt must not precede durability. Do not fabricate atomic external transactions.

Existing revokeConnectionBindingAndRevalidate matches consumer/credential, risking unintended revocation of unrelated capability grants; capability scope and active lease handling require precise authority semantics.

Exactly one provider effect after ambiguous timeout is not provided by a local ledger alone. Provider idempotency/readback/reconciliation support is a required adapter gate; no blind replay or fake success.
Connections route parsers currently discard details in multiple conversion branches; single-branch changes lose capability IDs on history/reload/deep links.
SourceInfo onSourcesChanged resets edit drafts; catalog reactivity must preserve allowed scoped drafts and remove denied sensitive content after revoke rather than retain it globally.
Pool disconnection returns empty cached tool list and catalog must distinguish genuine empty from needs_auth/degraded/unavailable discovery; stale_schema must invalidate previews.
Canonical Rox2Status enums must not be expanded to represent capability-specific states; provider/local/readback outcomes remain separate domain results.
Root integration can change inspected sources during preflight. Hash drift invalidates affected evidence; report does not claim HEAD/source cleanliness or an implementation revision.
No builds/tests/native UI/network were executed. All feature/runtime acceptance remains unverified and this report cannot close issue1113.
